subject: Request: short-term rebate & discount for Split-Inference rollout delay
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term rebate ask while Split-Inference rollout completes

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the candid call this morning. I wanted to follow up in writing so your procurement team has a single place to reference. As we discussed, NovaHealth has been running heavier-than-expected inference traffic since you started the pilot, and our Split-Inference rollout (the optimizer that reduces duplicate model compute across parallel requests) is estimated to be delayed by ~6 weeks due to a regression in the sharding coordinator. That means your token costs for May will be higher than the model in our original SOW implied.

Proposed remediation (short-term):
- One-time rebate of 15% on inference usage for May 2027 (applied as a credit)
- A temporary per-request discount (5% off per-token rate) for the duration of the rollback window, capped at $40k
- We will provide a diagnostic report (usage_summary_apr_2027.csv) and a proposed rebate term (attached) outlining the math.

Next steps I need from NovaHealth: a confirmation email that those two remedies would make you comfortable continuing the paid pilot while we finish the fix. From our side, I’ll need an exec sign-off. I’ve looped in Marissa (sales ops) and Karthik (product) for impact analysis.

Appreciate the patience — we want to keep the pilot momentum and make NovaHealth whole for an engineering delay on our side.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage_summary_apr_2027.csv (CSV, 42KB); proposed_rebate_term_v1.docx (DOCX, 12KB)

From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term rebate ask while Split-Inference rollout completes

Thanks Marcus —

We appreciate the transparency. Procurement is OK with a one-time adjustment if it’s clearly bounded. Couple quick asks from my side:
1) Can you confirm the exact window the rebate covers (start/end dates)?
2) We need the discount/rebate documented on Redwood letterhead for our audit team before we process any credits.
3) Will this impact SLAs or support response expectations during the fix?

If you can get a short executive note and a capped amount, procurement can sign off quickly and keep the pilot live. I’ll loop our finance lead if we get legal doc.

— Alex
Director, Procurement
NovaHealth

On Sat, May 1, 2027 at 9:18 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original message quoted]"

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Short-term rebate ask while Split-Inference rollout completes (need exec sign-off)

Team — forwarding NovaHealth’s confirmation request. Quick bullets from analysis:
- Impact: Based on their April usage, a 15% one-time rebate for May would be ~$28k credit; the additional 5% per-token discount capped at $40k is conservative and keeps us within commercial guardrails.
- Technical status: The sharding coordinator regression is localized; expected deploy to staging this week, production rollback next week (target +4 to +6 weeks absolute worst case if we hit unexpected edge cases).
- Support: No change to SLA; we will keep P1 on-call and provide daily syncs to Alex during the remediation window.

Requested approval text for execs: 
"Redwood will issue a one-time credit equal to 15% of NovaHealth's May 2027 inference spend (applied to July invoice), and enable a temporary 5% per-token rate discount until the Split-Inference production fix is complete, capped at $40,000. Redwood support and SLAs remain unchanged."

Can one of you (Aditya/Laura) take this to execs for sign-off? If we can get a short signed note and a DocuSign wrapper, I’ll send to Nova.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_rebate_term_v1.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short-term rebate ask while Split-Inference rollout completes (exec approval)

Copying in Aditya for final sign-off. I’ve run the wording by legal — they asked that we add an explicit cap and a recovery clause (if the fix finishes early we prorate the discount). I also confirmed with finance that applying the credit to the July invoice is fine.

Aditya — approved as proposed below with legal tweak. Suggest we send the DocuSign today. Final approved text (for DocuSign):

"Redwood Inference confirms a commercial accommodation to NovaHealth as follows: (1) a one-time credit equal to 15% of NovaHealth's inference spend for the billing period May 1–31, 2027, to be applied as a credit to the July 2027 invoice; (2) a temporary 5% per-token discount applied to billed inference usage from May 1, 2027 until the Split-Inference production fix is verified in production, not to exceed $40,000 in aggregate; (3) Redwood support levels and SLA obligations remain unchanged. If the production fix is completed prior to the end of May, any discounts shall be prorated.

Authorized by: Aditya Rao, Head of Revenue Operations
Date: 2027-05-04

I will prepare the DocuSign envelope and include the HubSpot deal link.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Forwarded attachments: proposed_rebate_term_v1.docx; usage_summary_apr_2027.csv"
